title: Forge Evaluation Context v1
description: Structural schema for a ForgeEvaluationContext — everything a rule may read besides the raw canonical document. Contains no secrets and no executable content. See docs/bible/06-forge/097-rule-context-model.md. CURRENT implementation note: the running validation engine (backend/jewelmind/validation/engine.py) only ever receives 'document' — every other field here is either derivable at the API layer (compilerVersion, geometryGeneratorVersion) or PLANNED (generatedGeometryMetadata, componentManifest are populated only after generation, and no current rule reads them back).

document.description: The JDL Canonical Document being evaluated — structurally, a document conforming to specs/jdl/v1/jdl.schema.json. Not $ref'd directly to avoid cross-file resolution fragility in this specification; a full-context validator should validate this sub-object against that schema separately.

generatedGeometryMetadata.description: PLANNED — populated only once FORGE-6 (geometry generation) has run; null before that stage. No CURRENT rule reads this.

componentManifest.description: PLANNED — mirrors GeneratedModel.components once generation has occurred; null before that stage.

professionalRuleProfile.description: PLANNED — a named bundle of professionally-validated rules for a given scope. No profile exists today because zero rules are professionally validated.
